snippet.title: Business Heroes: Street Grub Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Ready to flip burgers and crunch numbers?
Become the mastermind behind a street-food empire in Business Heroes: Street Grub. The free Steam demo is out now. Inspired by the cult favourite Lemonade Tycoon, this turn-based simulation challenges you to grow one humble food truck into a global juggernaut. 

What’s inside the demo?
Four single-player modes: Tutorial, Limited Career, One Challenge and Limited Sandbox. Outsell rivals, climb the leaderboards, and prove you have the sharpest business instincts on the street. 

Every decision counts.
Tweak menus and prices, manage staff morale, track real-time city economics, and react to disasters or influencer buzz. Dig into deep financial reports, expand across 15 capital cities, and watch your valuation soar. No two playthroughs are the same. 

Play the demo, wishlist the game, and join our Discord to share your story.
Steam demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1429080
Discord: https://discord.gg/businessheroes

#BusinessHeroes #StreetGrub #IndieGame #Tycoon #Simulation
